text:
Priya S: Hey team — ProofFlow (POC) asked for the compliance bundle so they can kick off legal review. They specifically want: SOC 2 Type II report, ISO 27001 cert excerpt, signed pen-test attestation (one‑page letter), and a short control mapping to our product features. Can security/legal confirm what we can share?

Eli G: We can share SOC 2 Type II exec summary + cover letter. Full report requires an NDA and data-room access. Pen-test attestation: we have a standard signed letter from RedTeamOps that we can provide.

Kelsey R: Customer asks whether providing those artifacts will trigger any additional Dedicated pricing or new contract clauses. Sales needs a clear ask to communicate.

Mia L: For POC we usually do a limited bundle: SOC2 summary, ISO cert PDF, pen-test attestation letter (redacted vuln details), network diagram (public-facing only), and a checklist mapping controls->features. That has worked for prior banks.

Priya S: Good. ProofFlow also asked for staging IPs for their external scan window and a presigned S3 link to upload scan results. They want the window this week.

Jorge N: Staging IPs = 54.39.210.12/32 and 18.197.45.3/32 (ephemeral). For presigned upload, we can provide a short-lived PUT URL. Example we send ops: ```aws s3 presign s3://redwood-proofflow/poc-uploads/PROOFFLOW-scan.zip --expires-in 3600```

Eli G: Note: we must not accept raw scan reports into prod buckets. Use a dedicated staging bucket and set lifecycle to 14d. Also require recipients to remove PII before upload.

Kelsey R: Pricing question — @finance, is there a surcharge for audit-support requested during POC? If legal review demands full report access/dataroom, sales flagged a potential uplift.

Priya S: ProofFlow asked if a signed pen-test letter is enough for their procurement instead of the full scope. Legal?

Eli G: Pen-test attestation letter states: "Redwood Inference attests to a third-party penetration test dated 2025-11-02 and provides remediation status summary." That usually satisfies procurement for POCs. If they insist on raw findings we escalate to NDA + secured dataroom.

AuditBot: Reminder: SOC 2 artifact package requires a single point of contact and timestamped delivery. Create a ticket in #assurance with tag `pf-proofflow` for audit trail.

Mia L: Action items: (1) Security to prepare pen-test attestation letter and SOC2 exec summary (Eli) (2) Infra to issue presigned S3 URL and staging IP window (Jorge) (3) Sales to confirm whether ProofFlow signs our standard NDA or needs modified legal terms (Kelsey) (4) I will assemble control mapping doc template and populate POC-specific rows.

Eli G: ETA for artifacts: SOC2 exec summary + pen-test letter by EOD tomorrow if no legal redlines.

Jorge N: Presigned URL + IP window created — will DM the link to Kelsey and Priya when ready. Window suggested: Thu 10:00–14:00 PST.

Kelsey R: I'll ask finance about any uplift and confirm with ProofFlow whether NDA is acceptable. Also asking procurement who signs is helpful.

Priya S: Thanks. If legal needs the signed pen-test letter template, @Eli I'll need the signed PDF (scanned) not just a text blob. Any chance to get a signature?

Eli G: Yes, will get it signed by Head of Security and attach PDF. :thumbsup:

Mia L: Quick note for packaging: include a one‑page cover note that lists what is included and a guidance paragraph for reviewers (what we redact and why). That reduces back-and-forth.

Priya S: Perfect. This thread is the single source for ProofFlow POC evidence. I'll ping again if procurement wants deeper artifacts. Thanks all. :pray:
